about.bio1: Dr. Mayank Ahooja is a Doctor of Medicine, Meditation Master, Spiritual Coach, and Motivational Speaker dedicated to helping individuals explore greater calmness, balance, self-awareness, and inner harmony.
about.bio2: With more than 15 years of experience in energy-focused and chakra-based practices, Dr. Ahooja combines meditation, breathing techniques, sound and vibration practices, color visualization, and energy-focused approaches to create personalized wellness experiences.
about.bio3: His approach is centered around the understanding that meaningful change begins with awareness of the mind, emotions, body, and inner self.
about.personalQuote: True transformation begins when clear, grounded understanding meets the profound stillness of your own spirit.

medicalBackground.title: Doctor of Medicine (M.D.)
medicalBackground.subtitle: Clear Understanding of the Mind, Brain & Body
medicalBackground.text: Educated as a Doctor of Medicine, Dr. Mayank approaches personal wellness with a clear foundation in how the body and mind naturally work together. He understands the real physical toll that ongoing stress, daily pressure, and emotional exhaustion take on your energy, focus, and overall well-being. Rather than treating meditation as something abstract, he anchors every practice in everyday reality—guiding you back to a natural state of ease, restful recovery, and lasting calm.
highlights: Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) education and scientific training
Clear understanding of stress patterns, daily fatigue, and the mind-body connection
Practical approach to easing tiredness, physical tension, and daily overwhelm
Safe, gentle practices that support your everyday health and lifestyle

spiritualJourney.title: Meditation & Inner Journey
spiritualJourney.subtitle: From Thoughtful Observation to Inner Peace
spiritualJourney.text: Dr. Mayank's inner journey began over 15 years ago when he recognized that true peace, lasting purpose, and emotional balance come from reconnecting with who we are inside. Committing deeply to personal practice, he immersed himself in meditation, breath awareness, energy alignment, and calming sound practices. Over a decade and a half of dedicated practice has shaped his ability to create a warm, welcoming space and guide individuals through busy days and emotional overwhelm into grounded stillness.
highlights: Over 15 years of continuous daily meditation practice and personal reflection
Deep experience with energy alignment, breath awareness, and sound relaxation
Personal guidance through life transitions, personal growth, and feeling overwhelmed
A compassionate, grounded presence shaped by hundreds of personal sessions

faqs.q: What happens if I miss a live cohort session?
faqs.a: All live virtual sessions are recorded in high audio fidelity and uploaded to your secure participant portal within 12 hours, accompanied by session summaries and practice guides.

faqs.q: Do I need prior experience with meditation or breathwork?
faqs.a: No prior experience is necessary. Dr. Mayank provides progressive, step-by-step guidance suitable for beginners while providing profound depth for experienced practitioners.

faqs.q: How does the cohort inquiry and selection process work?
faqs.a: After submitting your inquiry, our sanctuary team will schedule a brief 10-minute alignment consultation to understand your personal intentions and confirm your placement in the upcoming cohort.

faqs.q: Can these programs be adapted for private teams or corporate offsites?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer customized half-day, full-day, and multi-week corporate wellness programs specifically tailored for executive teams, healthcare institutions, and creative organizations.

faq.headline: Everything You Need to Know

items.q: What is the focus of a Consultation with Dr. Mayank Ahooja?
items.a: A consultation is a personalized, confidential dialogue exploring your wellness goals, emotional balance, stress triggers, and establishing a tailored guidance path encompassing meditation, breathing, and energetic practices.

items.q: Do I need prior meditation or chakra experience?
items.a: Not at all. Dr. Ahooja welcomes individuals at every stage of their journey, guiding beginners with effortless simplicity and supporting advanced practitioners toward deeper stillness.

items.q: Are sessions conducted in person or virtually?
items.a: Both. Sessions are held in our tranquil sanctuary in Chișinău, Moldova, as well as virtually through secure high-definition video consultations for individuals worldwide.

items.q: Are these practices a substitute for medical consultation?
items.a: No. These practices are designed for everyday wellness, relaxation, and self-awareness to help you find personal harmony. They do not replace professional medical advice or consultation.

sections.title: Nature of Holistic Services
points: Holistic sessions (meditation, breathwork, energy balance) are complementary wellness practices.
Sessions are not clinical consultations and do not create a doctor-patient relationship.
These services do not diagnose, treat, or replace licensed medical healthcare.

sections.title: Individual Results & No Guarantees
points: Results vary naturally from person to person based on individual factors.
We do not make medical or therapeutic outcome guarantees.
Progress is a collaborative effort between the practitioner and participant.

sections.title: Not a Substitute for Medical Advice
points: Always consult a licensed healthcare professional for any medical or mental health condition.
Never stop, alter, or delay prescribed medical treatment in favor of holistic practices.
Information shared is for educational and wellness cultivation purposes only.

sections.title: Participant Responsibility
points: Participation in all sessions and practices is completely voluntary.
You assume full personal responsibility for your choices, actions, and lifestyle habits.
You agree to engage with mindful presence, honesty, and mutual respect.

sections.title: Confidentiality & Privacy
points: All personal information and discussions in sessions are kept strictly confidential.
Booking details (name, email, phone, notes) are used solely to coordinate your sessions.
We never sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties.

sections.title: Session Language
points: All 1:1 consultations and group programs are conducted in English and Russian only.
You confirm comfortable conversational proficiency in either English or Russian.
Live sessions in other languages are not currently available.

sections.title: Informed Consent
points: Booking a session confirms you have read and agreed to these terms in full.
You voluntarily consent to receive complementary wellness and meditation guidance.
We appreciate your commitment to responsible, respectful participation.

sections.title: Changes to These Terms
points: These terms may be updated periodically to reflect service or regulatory changes.
